candidate_relations.reason: The acute event followed upper-airway obstruction by compacted snow, with haemoptysis and bilateral alveolar infiltrates supporting negative-pressure pulmonary oedema with pulmonary haemorrhage. Brief exposure at 2500 m does not support HAPE as the specified diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Pulmonary oedema with an incompatible high-altitude etiology and without the required pulmonary haemorrhage component.
